Growth & station models

All eight ages, from sprout to harvest. Rendered from the shipped model geometry and texture coordinates.

Onion

Garlic

Tomato

Rice

Corn

Pepper

Cooking Station

Icons are shown at 3× and at their native 32×32 size on dark and light backgrounds. Block previews use approximate source lighting; a Minecraft client playtest is still required. Artwork created with built-in image generation and locally packaged. Prompts and provenance: art/items/*.json and each crop/station Blockbench folder.
